captions.text: In Core, Inventory separates the item catalogue from what
the department currently holds.
On hand provides Items and Location filters, while Unit and Person lookups
help identify a particular holder.
Start by choosing the right item and location before interpreting a quantity.
This walkthrough follows one fictional training consumable through recorded
software movements, rather than claiming that anyone physically
inspected or transported supplies.

captions.text: The Items tab lists catalogue entries and their Tracking mode and Status.
New item opens the catalogue workflow.
On How it is tracked, this example uses By quantity with Track lots
and Expiration required selected.
Controlled substance and Kit item remain off.
Decide how an item should be tracked before stock exists;
later changes can be restricted.
Industrial teams can apply the same distinction to bulk consumables
and individually tracked equipment.

batteries, measured in packs, with its code and description.
